_note: PAT-219 lifecycle guard (readiness review Critical #2). Phase 1: the measure is created via POST /api/measures and stays `draft`, so $evaluate-measure must be refused with HTTP 409 + ErrorResponse.error = 'Measure Not Evaluable' BEFORE any FHIR/CQL work happens. Phase 2: submit-for-review + approve flips it to `active`; the identical evaluate call now returns 200 with a real cohort result (4 of the 6 seeded patients are >=18 at 2021-12-31). Proves the guard is keyed on lifecycle status, not on the eCQM publish path, and that the approval workflow lifts it without a restart. The measure is deliberately created WITHOUT ownerUsername — the shape the UI's create dialog and most API clients produce — which is also the BUG-143 regression lock: approve/reject of an ownerless measure used to hit notification.recipient NOT NULL and roll back with a misleading 409.
